demo.title: bankrns.sh
demo.code:
# Send tokens to a .bankr name
bankr prompt "Using the bankrns skill, send 10 USDC to alice.bankr"

# Buy a name (two steps, ~60s apart; you approve each)
bankr prompt "Using the bankrns skill, buy me satoshi.bankr for 2 years"
bankr prompt "Using the bankrns skill, register bob.bankr and point it to 0xABC..."

# Look up
bankr prompt "Using the bankrns skill, is alice.bankr available and how much?"
bankr prompt "Using the bankrns skill, what is my .bankr name?"

# Renew
bankr prompt "Using the bankrns skill, renew alice.bankr for 1 year"

setup: Chain: Base (8453). Names are ERC-721 NFTs from BankrNS, an ENS-architecture name service
Install script dependencies once: cd scripts && npm install (Node 18+, viem)
Sending: the skill resolves the name, shows the address, and sends with Bankr's own transfer tool after you confirm; expired, unregistered or unset names never resolve
Buying: commit + register (>= 60s apart) to the RegistrarController 0x1C8b3a9062a8Aae65105519B394d7ec73C108ee9; every write is previewed with its ETH price and needs your explicit approval
Prices in ETH at the live Chainlink rate: $5/yr (5+ chars), $80/yr (4 chars), $320/yr (3 chars); overpayment is refunded on-chain
Inside bankrbot the scripts only build transactions (--build-only) and bankrbot submits them; standalone use submits via the Bankr Wallet API with BANKR_API_KEY
Official token $BNS: 0x3A23C04dc7b5b6859B68050dB2fcDfFd30793Ba3 (always by address, never by ticker)
Contracts and addresses: references/addresses.md. Source, tests and SDK: https://github.com/0xleventis/bankrns-skill
